texts: The reservoir of the Stilllight Lantern holds enough mire-essence to burn for one night.
The Council built the Stilllight Lantern because wraiths had risen again and again.

fields.sentence: The reservoir of the Stilllight Lantern holds enough mire-essence to burn for one night.

review.notes: One tension worth recording: for "enough N to V" the degree rule says to reify the consequence "with x as Agent", while the general role test makes the burning essence an unaccusative undergoer — the parse's (Patient sk_burn_1 sk_mire_essence_1) follows the role doctrine and reads as the faithful choice. Everything else checks out: PartOf for the reservoir, the kind atom off the name-internal "Lantern", stative-transitive Agent for holds (the prompt's own "the tank holds" case), quantity Degree sufficient, and the positive Can-marked consequence with its duration Measure.

fields.sentence: The Council built the Stilllight Lantern because wraiths had risen again and again.

q1_issues.issue: The bare-plural group 'wraiths' gets only the group-level rise event; a distributive predicate over a group is also supposed to hand the predication to the members via an (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) ...) rule, which is absent.

q2_gaps: reduplicated iterative adverbial ('again and again') on an episodic past-perfect clause — the unary (Again e) tag records only that some prior same-type event occurred, and no licensed head carries the repeated multiplicity (Every/TimesPer need a stated period or rate, and the frequency-adverb dial is for generics/habituals)
review.notes: Name/kind handling of 'the Stilllight Lantern', the no-Name default for 'the Council', the past-perfect Before ordering and the main-clause-first Because atom are all correct.

issues.reason: Rising is distributive (each wraith rises separately), and the instruction set states without qualification that a distributive predicate over a plural OR GROUP also hands the predication to the members via a (PartOf $x <group>) rule — the bare-plural-episodic passage settles only that the subject is a group witness rather than a kind-ranging generic, not that the per-member rule lapses.

gaps_confirmed: A reduplicated iterative adverbial ('again and again') on an episodic clause: the unary (Again e) records only that a prior same-type event occurred, and no licensed head carries the repeated multiplicity (Every/TimesPer need a stated period or rate; the frequency dial is generic/habitual only).
adjudication.defect_summary: The compliant form adds, beside the group-level rise event, (Implication (PartOf $x sk_group_1) (And (Member (sk_rise $x) rise) (Agent (sk_rise $x) $x) (Past (sk_rise $x)))) at (STV 1.0 0.9).
adjudication.notes: Name/kind handling of 'the Stilllight Lantern', the no-Name default for 'the Council', the past-perfect Before ordering and the main-clause-first Because atom are all correct, and (Again sk_rise_1) under-records the iterative without asserting anything false.
